cues.title: The solar system on {name}, seen from just above the plane of the planets: the Sun, eight worlds on their orbits, and a golden thread that joins sixteen silent machines.
cues.map: A map of the solar system on {name}, seen from above. {alt} Every machine NASA left behind is marked where it rests today: four on the Moon, seven on Mars, one on the asteroid Eros, one around Ceres, one behind the Earth, two far outside the planets. A golden thread joins them in the order they were launched. Sizes are not to scale and distances are compressed.
cues.far: The whole map from far away on {name}. The planets are a small disc around the Sun. Pioneer 10 and Voyager 1 are far outside it, and Voyager 1 has climbed high above the plane of the planets. Their positions are approximate.
